title: 11 Unique Personalized Gifts: 2026 Guide
summary: These unique personalized gifts can help mark special occasions. Find gift ideas from Shopify brands plus tips for businesses on how to sell custom gifts.
body_markdown:
A monogrammed journal. A hand-drawn family portrait. Chocolates embossed with your initials. Personalization transforms an already good gift into a great one and gives businesses the opportunity to create memorable moments for their customers and upsell products for special occasions.


The gifting market is vast: In 2025, the[National Retail Federation](https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/consumers-to-spend-second-highest-amount-on-record-according-to-nrf-holiday-survey) (NRF) reported that Americans planned to spend an average of[$890 on gifts](https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/consumers-to-spend-second-highest-amount-on-record-according-to-nrf-holiday-survey) , food, and décor for Christmas. National spending for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, and Valentine’s Day in 2026 was expected to reach $[38 billion](https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/mother-s-day-spending-expected-to-hit-record-38-billion) ,[$28 billion](https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/father-s-day-spending-to-hit-record-27-9-billion) , and[$29 billion](https://nrf.com/media-center/press-releases/valentine-s-day-spending-expected-to-reach-new-records) , respectively. Creating products specifically geared toward these events can help your brand stand out and become a staple on their holiday list.


In this article, you’ll find ideas for unique gifts for every occasion and person, as well as tips for brands on how to incorporate and sell personalized items.


## Ideas for unique personalized gifts


- Romantic partner
- Friends and family
- Kids
- Corporate gifts
- Wedding gifts and party favors


Personalized items make meaningful gifts, whether they’re in honor of a special occasion like a birthday, anniversary, or holiday, or as a way to let someone know you’re thinking of them. Here are a few ideas, categorized by both recipient and occasion:


### Romantic partner


What to get the person you know best (and who can likely guess your every move)? Here are a few time-honored and original ways to celebrate your partnership:


#### Wall art


Custom art can be funny, heartfelt, or inspired by a romantic partner’s favorite comic, show, or artist for a thoughtful anniversary gift. Take custom pet portraits, for example, which depict the recipient’s pet in a regal outfit and pose.


*Source:[Purr & Mutt](https://www.purrandmutt.com/en-us/collections/pet-portraits)*


#### Flowers


A bouquet is one of the easiest gifts to personalize. At[Fresh Sends](https://freshsends.com/) , for example, each order arrives with a custom card and themed add-ons, like their birthday bouquet paired with cookies from Funny Face Bakery.


“We really do feel like it is one of the biggest honors to remind people that they’re seen, known, and loved in life,” Cofounder Ty Hiss says on an episode of the[Shopify Masters podcast](https://www.shopify.com/blog/fresh-sends-floral-delivery-customization-in-business) . “Ninety-five percent of our product is gifted to someone else. We have the person who’s spending the money, and then we have the person who is receiving the product; we want to make sure both of them are really happy with the end result.”


Extra care with[product packaging](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-packaging) (like a message on the insert or well-designed cards) elevates a personalized gift to a grand gesture.


*Source:[Fresh Sends](https://freshsends.com/products/the-birthday-send)*


#### Jewelry


Personalized jewelry allows shoppers to memorialize an inside joke, anniversary, shared values, or family members who have passed. It can make an otherwise simple piece of jewelry feel bespoke.


*Source: Instagram via[Made by Mary](https://madebymary.com/)*


### Friends and family


Personalized gifts make it easy to find something for a broad group of people with shared history. Here are some ideas:


#### Mugs


Personalized mugs and kitchen accessories are a practical and unique way to bring your loved ones a little extra joy each day. For example, independent artisans like[Bumblebee Ceramics](https://bumblebeeceramics.com/) upgrade the standard photo mug with a handcrafted silhouette and custom rim colors.


*Source:[Bumblebee Ceramics](https://bumblebeeceramics.com/products/photo-to-mug)*


#### Puzzles


Custom puzzles give recipients an activity to look forward to with their gift. The puzzle brand[Piecework](https://pieceworkpuzzles.com/) , for example, lets customers add gift notes inside individual puzzle orders or transform a standalone image into a custom puzzle.


*Source:[Piecework](https://pieceworkpuzzles.com/)*


### Kids


The options for personalized gifts for kids are almost endless: think custom baby blankets, monogrammed comfy chairs and backpacks, personal stationery, and more:


#### Books


Hand-drawn storybooks like those from[My Story Tale](https://www.mystorytale.com/) have illustrated versions of kids and their families. You can customize characters, names, and other details so your book mirrors your kids’ lives.


*Source:[My Story Tale](https://www.mystorytale.com/)*


#### School gear


Backpacks, lunchboxes, notebooks, and other school gear can be a practical and personal gift, and having a kid’s name on it can make it special and help them (or their teachers) keep track of who it belongs to. This bag from Kindred Bravely has the option for adding custom embroidery, and matching lunch boxes and nap mats with the same customization options.


*Source:[Kindred Bravely](https://www.kindredbravely.com/)*


### Corporate gifts


Corporate gifts—like company merchandise or personalized conference giveaways—are a great way to both encourage[brand recognition](https://www.shopify.com/blog/brand-recognition-vs-brand-awareness) among new or potential clients and boost[company culture](https://www.shopify.com/blog/what-is-corporate-culture) for current employees:


#### Accessories


Branded water bottles, like the ones from[Stanley](https://www.stanley1913.com/) and[Hydro Flask](https://www.hydroflask.com/engraving?srsltid=AfmBOopP-uR-2wkIxYL_EMD06JRYAinwBB53_w_uhMQB7aj96HQdpGR7) , are popular corporate gifts—you can add your brand name to distribute to clients, or even your employees’ names for a more personalized gift. If wellness is a top priority for your company culture, brands like[Manduka](https://www.manduka.com/) offer[co-branded yoga mats](https://www.manduka.com/pages/custom-yoga-mats?srsltid=AfmBOorfYWTXds8VRJIF_-WveWHmPlioRTt9i3yiYYzL1M9khCwc1BOT) to inspire your community.


*Source:[Stanley](https://www.stanley1913.com/products/adventure-quencher-travel-tumbler-40-oz?variant=44559859712127)*


#### Edible gifts


Chocolates and sweets are easy-to-personalize giveaways for corporate events and holiday gifting.


*Source:[Dandelion Chocolate](https://www.dandelionchocolate.com/pages/corporate-gifts)*


### Wedding gifts and party favors


Much like a large professional event, momentous personal events, like weddings or celebrations, are a natural fit for personalized products:


#### Edible favors


Custom-labeled or monogrammed favors bring shared tastes to life, like honey from[Chandler Honey](https://chandlerhoney.ca/) or takeaway truffles from[Compartés](https://compartes.com/pages/gourmet-chocolate-wedding-favors?srsltid=AfmBOor6o6WEEhPxlg4bwBE3j5xeE6wFfHC1I-vY2l6duHiSZ9fMy7yh) .


*Source:[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/chandlerhoneycanada/posts/are-you-getting-married-in-2022chandler-honey-is-now-delighted-to-launch-our-cus/517275983282781/)* *Source:[Compartés](https://compartes.com/pages/gourmet-chocolate-wedding-favors?srsltid=AfmBOor6o6WEEhPxlg4bwBE3j5xeE6wFfHC1I-vY2l6duHiSZ9fMy7yh)*


#### Kitchenware


Couples getting married are often in the process of setting up their home. Personalized drinkware, cutting boards, and other essentials, can be both practical and a memento marking their new life together.


*Source:[Urban Engravings](https://www.urban-engravings.com/)*


### Tips for selling unique personalized gifts


- Personalize gifts for media outreach
- Incorporate print-on-demand apps
- Build iterations into the workflow


According to[Market Reports World](https://www.marketreportsworld.com/market-reports/personalized-gifts-market-14721999) , consumer demand for personalized products has increased by nearly 47% since 2020. If you’ve decided to prioritize a customization vertical for your products, here are a few best practices to adopt:


### Personalize gifts for media outreach


Pitching products personalized to brands, rather than individuals, can be a great way to earn organic press coverage in notable round-up lists, boosting your visibility.


Before she became known for her irreverent candle designs at[Candier](https://www.shopryanporter.com/collections/all-candles?srsltid=AfmBOorHNA4LfTyRONvqOII3vYM6sb3G1jAT3rKqpZJdqopBHsR3Kvl6) , Krysten Kauder founded Ryan Porter, which was known for custom alphabet bracelets. In the early days, she taught herself to make the bracelets as a hobby, until they caught the eye of Seventeen magazine, which reached out asking Krysten for custom designs—and then featured them on their Instagram.


“From then on, I was like, ‘I’m gonna DM everybody,”” Krysten says on *[Shopify Masters](https://www.shopify.com/blog/candier-sassy-candles-serious-business)* . “I’d find an editor, DM them, and offer to send them a personalized bracelet.” Creating custom bracelets for rising trends and pitching directly to staffers earned the brand multiple appearances on the Today show and Good Morning America. “That blew us up,” she says.


### Incorporate print-on-demand apps


[Print-on-demand (POD) apps](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/dropshipping/recommended-dropshipping-and-pod-apps) like[Gelato](https://apps.shopify.com/gelato-print-on-demand) make it possible to offer customization options like personalized engraving, custom text on T-shirts, apparel, totes, and other one-off products. It also allows businesses to create and iterate on designs without investing in inventory.


For example, apparel company[Life is Good](https://lifeisgood.com/) has a product customizer so customers can add text and images to clothing. They also come up with new designs weekly and experiment with what’s working without needing to print orders in advance. The brand also started a spin-off company,[Keep it Simple,](https://keepitsimple.co/) that supports other brands and creators looking to create their own print-on-demand pieces.


By buying their own POD machine and reshoring production to the United States, the brand was able to bring personalized ideas to life quickly. “We were able to reduce our lead times from six months down to literally two and a half days,” President Tom Hassell says on *[Shopify Masters](https://www.shopify.com/blog/life-is-good-optimism-on-demand)* . So if an artist creates a new graphic on Monday, we can be selling that graphic online on Wednesday afternoon because we’re showing it as a virtual item, and it doesn’t actually exist until after the customer places the order.


### Build iterations into the workflow


Depending on how detailed your custom products will be, build a rigorous review process into your workflow to ensure customer satisfaction before production. Run through the process a few times to get an idea of how long the average custom order will take so you can set customer expectations accordingly.


Portrait makers[Happy Tooned](https://happytooned.com/pages/faqs?srsltid=AfmBOorn4C9bXhBeYIT6YI3FZ7vtjTyiR83WM2hnOO_LvmqaIephE_1v) , for example, set turnaround expectations in their FAQ section and offer to make unlimited revisions until customers are satisfied with each portrait. A personalized gift, especially one that relies on capturing someone’s likeness, depends on accuracy, so be prepared to offer customers a round or two of edits as needed to arrive at the final result.


## Unique personalized gifts FAQ


### What are some good personalized gift ideas?


Depending on the intended recipient, good personalized gifts include custom art and accessories either with their likeness or in a style they particularly love, high-quality photo mugs, monogrammed accessories, or gifts that turn a memory into something tangible, like a custom puzzle or engraved jewelry.


### How do you find personalized gifts?


Many companies offer customization options you can use to create personalized gifts. For example, brands like Made by Mary make custom jewelry, while My Story Tale customizes children’s stories to make them the central character. You can also create personalized candles, chocolate, journals, and accessories to create gifts for groups like employees, family members, and wedding guests.


### How do you sell custom gifts?


To sell custom gifts, you can create individual handcrafted premium items like artwork and other one-of-a-kind pieces, or offer customization on existing designs. You can do this in-house on existing products, or use a print-on-demand service that can add custom designs to plain shirts, caps, and tote bags.
